releaseNotes: Activity cards now expand and collapse smoothly on click, with a subtle hover highlight. Hover never opens or closes cards.
Materials, resource links and assignment completion controls remain available while cards are collapsed or animating.
Reduced-motion preferences and native keyboard/touch behavior are respected. Rapid clicks safely reverse the animation, with no added LMS requests or background timers.
Existing credentials, settings, student history, private assignment completion and saved resources are preserved.
